evidence_classes.pilot: pre-registered contrasts, n=1 per arm x fixture; direction/instrument validation only
evidence_classes.calibration: pipeline smoke; never an effect estimate
evidence_classes.confirmatory: pre-registered fresh held-out fixtures, 2 repetitions, frozen design; analysis-eligible for the promotion gate
evidence_classes.probe: targeted discovery, not an effect estimate
evidence_classes.portability_smoke: non-promotional portability check on a stronger model; frozen fixtures and scorer; never replaces the confirmatory conclusion
